confirm.title: NSPanel HAUI devices discovered
confirm.description: Found {count} ESPHome device(s) running HAUI firmware: {names}. Add them to a new NSPanel HAUI hub?

abort.already_configured: A hub with this name is already configured
abort.already_in_progress: A hub configuration is already in progress
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one NSPanel HAUI hub is supported
abort.no_devices_found: No NSPanel HAUI devices were detected. Install the HAUI firmware on an ESPHome device first.

reload.title: Reload hub
reload.description:
NSPanel HAUI could not start device {device}.

The error was: `{error}`.

Use the fix to retry starting the device, or check the logs for details. Reloading the NSPanel HAUI hub configuration retries starting device {device}.

hub_idle.title: NSPanel HAUI hub has no enabled devices
hub_idle.description:
The hub {hub} has no enabled devices.

Enable at least one device in the NSPanel HAUI editor, or add a new ESPHome device running the HAUI firmware. New HAUI devices can be added to the hub automatically.

init.title: Hub settings
init.description: The hub name is how NSPanel HAUI appears in Home Assistant. The formats below are the defaults every panel inherits; per-panel settings stay in the NSPanel HAUI editor.

data_description.date_format_locale: Used when a panel's date format is Default.

error.invalid_format: Use a strftime pattern with at least one % directive (for example %H:%M).

open_panel.name: Open panel
open_panel.description: Navigate to a specific panel.  If wakeup is enabled the display wakes first.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel key or UUID to navigate to (e.g. 'alarm', 'grid_0').

wakeup.name: Wake up first
wakeup.description: Wake the display before opening the panel.

close_panel.name: Close panel
close_panel.description: Close the current panel and return to the previous or home panel.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

wakeup.name: Wake up
wakeup.description: Wake the display and navigate to the wakeup or home panel.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

idle.name: Idle
idle.description: Enter the idle state immediately by opening the configured idle page (idle_panel), as if the page timeout had fired.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Show a notification on the panel with a title, message, icon, icon colour and sound.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

title.name: Title
title.description: Notification title shown on the panel.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Material Design Icon shown with the notification (e.g. 'mdi:bell').

icon_color.name: Icon color
icon_color.description: Icon colour as #rrggbb, an RGB565 number, [r, g, b] or an integer string. Leave empty to use the theme's text colour.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Sound played for the notification. 'none' keeps it silent.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds until auto-dismiss. 0 keeps it until dismissed.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.description: Open immediately and loop the notification's sound until it is dismissed on the panel.

force_show.name: Force show
force_show.description: Immediately open the notification even if another panel is displayed.

text_size.name: Text size
text_size.description: Popup body text size: "auto" (the largest font that fits the whole message on one page) or a font size 1-3.

reset_last_interaction.name: Reset last interaction
reset_last_interaction.description: Reset the panel idle timer as if the user just touched it.

device.name: Device
device.description: Target NSPanel device. If omitted, applies to all devices.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Offset in seconds applied to the reset point.

update_tft.name: Update TFT
update_tft.description: Install the TFT release the panel's firmware needs, another release (older ones included), or the TFT file at a URL.

device.name: Device
device.description: NSPanel device whose display should be updated.

version.name: Version
version.description: Optional GitHub release to install instead of the one the firmware needs, e.g. an older release. Cannot be combined with URL.

url.name: URL
url.description: Optional http(s) URL of a .tft file to install instead of the GitHub release the firmware needs. Cannot be combined with Version.

update_firmware.name: Update firmware
update_firmware.description: Install the firmware update Home Assistant offers for the panel, another GitHub release (older ones included), or the firmware OTA image at a URL.

device.name: Device
device.description: NSPanel device whose firmware should be installed.

version.name: Version
version.description: Optional GitHub release to install instead of the offered update, e.g. an older release. Cannot be combined with URL.

url.name: URL
url.description: Optional http(s) URL of a firmware OTA image (firmware.ota.bin, not the factory image). Cannot be combined with Version.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Draw an image into a rectangle on the page the panel is showing. The image is rebuilt from a few hundred rectangles in the display's own 65 536 colours, drawn in about half a second, and it disappears on the next page change. Best for logos, icons and graphics; a full-screen photo becomes a mosaic.

device.name: Device
device.description: NSPanel device to draw on. If omitted, applies to all devices.

url.name: URL
url.description: http(s) URL of the image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WebP). Cannot be combined with Path.

path.name: Path
path.description: The image as a file in the "www" folder of the Home Assistant configuration, for example "logo.png" for "www/logo.png". Cannot be combined with URL.

x.name: X
x.description: Left edge of the rectangle, in display pixels.

y.name: Y
y.description: Top edge of the rectangle, in display pixels.

w.name: Width
w.description: Width of the rectangle, in display pixels.

h.name: Height
h.description: Height of the rectangle, in display pixels.

progressive.name: Progressive
progressive.description: Draw a coarse version first, so the image appears almost at once and then sharpens.

quality.name: Quality
quality.description: How many rectangles the image may use; more is sharper and slower (0.12 s to about 1.5 s), down to one rectangle per display pixel in a small rectangle.

clear_image.name: Clear image
clear_image.description: Paint a rectangle back to the background colour of the page the panel is showing. Only a flat colour: on a page whose background is a picture the rectangle stays a block, so change the page instead.

device.name: Device
device.description: NSPanel device whose rectangle is cleared. If omitted, applies to all devices.

x.name: X
x.description: Left edge of the rectangle, in display pixels.

y.name: Y
y.description: Top edge of the rectangle, in display pixels.

w.name: Width
w.description: Width of the rectangle, in display pixels.

h.name: Height
h.description: Height of the rectangle, in display pixels.
